description: Read-only Hyperliquid pre-trade decision gate for opening a perpetual position on the Hyperliquid L1 venue (reviewed BTC and ETH markets today, USDC margin). Separately evaluates underlying and USDC cross-oracle consensus integrity on canonical mainnet feeds, checks caller-declared post-action leverage against a reviewed static profile capped by the freshly observed venue leverage limit, and attaches disclosed venue evidence (mark/oracle divergence, cross-venue consensus deviation, displayed depth) that can escalate the verdict. Returns ALLOW / CAUTION / BLOCK. Assessment-only: it does not evaluate the liquidation engine and never signs, submits, or authorizes an order; bind a successful result to an exact user-authorized order envelope separately.
name: hyperliquid_perp_guard
